question: The ‘EnVision’ mission of the European Space Agency is aimed at exploring which planet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **EnVision** mission is a venture led by the **European Space Agency (ESA)**, with significant contributions from **NASA**, specifically aimed at exploring the planet **Venus**.
 
• It was officially selected by the ESA’s Science Programme Committee on **June 10, 2021**, as the **fifth medium-class mission** (M5) in the agency's **Cosmic Vision** plan.
 
• The primary objective of the **EnVision** mission is to perform a comprehensive study of **Venus**, ranging from its **inner core** to its **upper atmosphere**, to understand why it evolved so differently compared to **Earth**.
 
• The mission is scheduled for launch in the **early 2030s**, with the earliest possible launch window opening in **2031**, followed by **2032** and **2033**.
 
• The spacecraft will utilize a suite of sophisticated instruments, including a Synthetic Aperture
